name: Layan Verde tropical-modern (PROPOSED palette)
note: One locked materials line for every room, so all stills read as one home. Proposed from Layan Verde's resort positioning; swap for the developer's finish schedule once you have the brochure.
materials: warm honed travertine floors, natural teak joinery, off-white lime-plaster walls, white linen upholstery, woven rattan accents, slim bronze window frames
light: soft late-afternoon tropical daylight through floor-to-ceiling glass
outside: lush green forested hills and a hazy Andaman Sea horizon beyond the terrace
camera: eye height 1.5 m, 18 mm lens, level verticals
negative: no people, no text, no logos, no added walls, doors or windows, no changed room proportions, no fisheye distortion, no warping
